result.summary: This PR refines the CheckUnparsable test helper in descriptor_tests.cpp so that it checks the exact error string produced when parsing the private-form descriptor, not just the public-form one, which previously overwrote it. It adds an overload accepting separate expected private and public errors, preserves the old three-argument interface for cases where both match, and updates affected test cases accordingly. It also fixes an unrelated test bug where a raw() private descriptor was paired with an sh() public descriptor.
result.problem: Before this change, CheckUnparsable reused a single error variable for both the private and public parse attempts, so the public parse's error silently overwrote the private parse's error before the assertion. This meant a wrong or missing private-form error message could pass the test undetected, weakening the test suite's ability to catch descriptor-parsing regressions for maintainers of descriptor code.
